size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the refresh endpoint's own service function (refreshAuth), which the prompt points at by naming POST /v1/auth/refresh-tokens.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/refresh-tokens rejects every refresh token with 401 'Please authenticate', including one issued by login seconds before. Login itself works.

root_cause.detail: refreshAuth verifies the token as tokenTypes.ACCESS instead of tokenTypes.REFRESH; no token record of that type exists, verifyToken throws and the catch turns it into 401.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/refresh-tokens > should return 200 and new auth tokens if refresh token is valid
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 200 and new auth tokens if refresh token is valid'
